code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows marked hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation), mild thrombocytopenia, mild microcytic anemia (low MCH), and significant leukocyte differential abnormalities: neutropenia, lymphopenia, monocytosis, and basophilia. Liver and kidney function, electrolytes, and glucose are within normal limits except for a mildly elevated alkaline phosphatase. Findings suggest possible acute or chronic hypoxic and/or inflammatory process; clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
